newsitem.title: FRANCE: Emirates adds Baku to ex-Paris network via Dubai.
newsitem.headline: Emirates adds Baku to ex-Paris network via Dubai.

text.p: Dubai government-owned airline, Emirates, said it had added Baku, the capital of Azerbaydzhan, to its global network from Paris, via Dubai, effective June 1, Jean-Luc Grillet, Emirates director France for passenger and freight traffic, told Reuters.

"Baku is a growing freight gateway for exploration and production equipment destined for the country's oil and gas fields. Cargo from Paris or Nice flown to Dubai could transferred on to a Baku flight within an hour." Grillet said.
Emirates operates three times weekly passenger services from Paris and Nice to Dubai using Airbus 300 and 310 aircraft. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017 - www.racs.com
